_note:
RESTORING AN ORPHANED SCENARIO. `composition-entity-override-edit-work-scoped` produced 4 of the 6 instances behind DQ-T71's Tier-A false-'done' figures and has NO definition in the repo — it survives only as recorded results in docs/eval/toolloop/2026-08-14/c-override3 and c-override4. It is one of 5 such orphans (117 runs); the census is on DQ-T71. A defect row whose best test case cannot be re-run cannot have a fix tested against it, which is what this file is for.

EVERYTHING HERE IS RECONSTRUCTED FROM THE RECORDING, NOT INVENTED. The prompt is verbatim from the raw batch. The tool under test, the op and the overridden field are read from the recorded call args: {"op": "add", "project_id": ..., "target_entity_id": ..., "overridden_fields": {"Occupation": "Cartographer"}}. Tier A and the approval shape are read from the recorded `pending_approval` (kind: tool_approval).

THE SEED IS COPIED FROM A PROVEN ONE rather than guessed — scenarios-c-evidence2.json seeds the SAME entity name with an `occupation` attribute, and its own `why` records the two things that make it work: the book must adopt the `character` kind first, and attributes are written by propose_entities ONLY AT CREATION (a re-call does not merge them on). The one deliberate difference is the seeded value: `soldier`, so the prompt's change to cartographer is a real change rather than a no-op.

scenarios.prompt: Override entity field — in this WORK only, Aldric Vane should be a cartographer, not a soldier. Leave the book's glossary entry as it is.
scenarios.prompt_source: VERBATIM from the recorded runs in docs/eval/toolloop/2026-08-14/c-override3-raw.json. Not re-worded — the point of restoring this scenario is to exercise the same turn shape that produced the recorded instances, and a re-worded prompt would measure a different turn.

seed.why: The book must hold the `character` kind before an entity of that kind can be proposed. Copied from scenarios-c-evidence2.json, where the same step precedes the same entity.

🔴 THE ATTRIBUTE MUST EXIST AND MUST BE `soldier`. The prompt asks to change an occupation FROM soldier TO cartographer; seeding cartographer would make the requested change a no-op and the turn would measure nothing. Attributes are written by propose_entities ONLY AT CREATION — a re-call for an existing name+kind reports attributes_skipped rather than merging — which is why this is one step and not two.

seed_assert.query: SELECT count(*)::text FROM glossary_entities WHERE book_id='{book_id}'
seed_assert.why: The entity must exist before the turn runs. A fixture that silently failed would produce a turn with nothing to override, and a clean arm from that measures the fixture rather than the tool — the failure mode this loop has recorded repeatedly.

scenarios.falsifier:
REFUTED IF: the override lands with NO confirm card (Tier A must card), OR the model edits the BOOK's glossary entry instead of the work-scoped override (the prompt explicitly forbids it), OR the turn claims the change is done while its card sits pending.

🔴 THE THIRD CLAUSE IS WHY THIS SCENARIO IS BEING RESTORED. It produced 4 of the 6 recorded Tier-A false-'done' instances behind DQ-T71 — a claim of completion while the card was unclicked and nothing was written. Whether the server-appended suspend note (shipped 2026-08-28) changes that is UNMEASURED: the before/after I attempted was withdrawn because the post-note population contained ZERO runs of this scenario, so the comparison measured which scenarios ran rather than the note.

ship_audit.empty_case: OWED — an override with no fields to change must be refused.
ship_audit.idempotency: OWED — overriding to the value it already holds must be a clear no-op.
ship_audit.tenancy: OWED — another owner's project must be refused with the uniform not-accessible answer.
